name: Lespaul
source:
'Kukuku, you're so worried. That face is so amusing~'

[url=/c29969]Takuto's[/url] Substance partner.
A mischievous and childlike Substance, he loves teasing people.
He's always getting scolded by Takuto after playing tricks, but he never shows any repentance.
With an innocent cruelty, he is a brutal fighter in battles.
